collections.name: Adrenaline Rush — Adventure Destinations
collections.description: Rafting, paragliding, skiing, trekking, and everything that gets your heart racing.

collections.name: After Dark — Night Experiences Worth Staying Up For
collections.description: India travel content assumes everyone is in bed by 9 PM. These destinations have legitimate after-dark experiences — from midnight temple ceremonies to stargazing at 4,000m to live music in Himalayan cafes.

collections.name: Andaman Diving & Snorkeling
collections.description: Best underwater experiences from beginner snorkeling at North Bay to PADI-certified deep dives at Havelock — clear waters Oct-May.

collections.name: Autumn Destinations — Where September to November Scores 5/5
collections.description: Monsoon ends, skies clear, tourists haven't returned, and the Himalayas put on their best show. Autumn is arguably the single best season to travel North India — and these destinations prove it with 5/5 scores across weather, crowds, and access.

collections.name: Ayurveda & Wellness Trail — Kerala's Healing Heritage
collections.description: Kerala is the global capital of Ayurveda. These destinations offer authentic treatments — not tourist spa packages.

collections.name: Best Beaches in India — Beyond Goa
collections.description: India has 7,500km of coastline. These are the beaches worth the trip — from sacred cliff beaches to turtle nesting sites to the whitest sand in Konkan.

collections.name: Best Dhabas on Every Highway
collections.description: 30 legendary dhabas on every major highway across North India. Real names, real dishes, real ratings — from Murthal to Chitkul, Yamuna Expressway to Manali-Leh.

collections.name: Best Family Destinations (Kids Will Actually Enjoy)
collections.description: Not every hill station is fun for kids. These are the places where children have genuine things to do, medical help is nearby, and parents can actually relax.

collections.name: Best Honeymoon Destinations
collections.description: The most romantic places in North India — palaces, lakes, valleys, and sunsets made for two.

collections.name: Best Motorcycle Routes in India
collections.description: Every road trip on this list has been scored for road conditions, fuel availability, phone signal, and altitude risk. These aren't travel-blog lists — this is what a biker actually needs to know.

collections.name: Best on ₹1000/Day
collections.description: Incredible destinations where ₹1000/day covers stay, food, and transport. Real budget travel, no compromises on experience.

collections.name: Best on ₹2,000/Day — Comfort Without Compromise
collections.description: You do not have to suffer to travel cheap. These destinations offer clean rooms, solid food, and real experiences for under ₹2,000 per day — midrange comfort, not survival mode. Every price verified against actual 2026 costs.

collections.name: Best on ₹5,000/Day — The Sweet Spot
collections.description: The ₹5,000/day tier unlocks the best of North India without the luxury price tag. Good hotels, guided experiences, comfortable transport, and restaurant meals — the tier where you stop counting and start enjoying.

collections.name: Best Photography Destinations
collections.description: Places where every frame is a keeper — dramatic light, layered landscapes, vibrant culture, and that golden hour magic.

collections.name: Best Stargazing Spots (Dark Sky Locations)
collections.description: Near-zero light pollution. Milky Way visible to naked eye.

collections.name: Best Winter Destinations (Dec-Feb)
collections.description: Places that transform in winter — fresh snow, frozen lakes, clear Himalayan views, and that crisp mountain air.

collections.name: Birding Hotspots of India
collections.description: India has 1,300+ bird species — more than all of Europe combined. These six locations are where serious birders go, scored for the best viewing months. Not a birdwatching "tour" — a field guide to where, when, and what you will see.

collections.name: Borders Worth Visiting
collections.description: Where nations meet, culture collides, and geography forces impossible compromises. India's border destinations are more than lines on a map.

collections.name: Coffee & Tea Plantation Stays — Wake Up in the Estates
collections.description: Sleep where your morning cup grows. These plantation stays put you inside working estates — mist, mountains, and the smell of fresh coffee at dawn.

collections.name: Eastern Ghats Adventure — AP's Wild Side
collections.description: Coffee valleys, sub-zero hamlets, tribal forests, and India's Grand Canyon — the Eastern Ghats are South India's best-kept adventure secret.

collections.name: French India Heritage Trail
collections.description: 300 years of French colonial influence — Puducherry White Town to Karaikal temples.

collections.name: Frozen Lakes & Rivers
collections.description: When the Himalayas freeze — landscapes from another planet.

collections.name: Glamping in North India — Luxury Under Canvas
collections.description: Tents with real beds, hot showers, and mountain views. Glamping in India ranges from riverside camps in Rishikesh to luxury tents at 4,000m in Ladakh. None of these require you to carry a sleeping bag.

collections.name: Goa Beyond Beaches — The Goa Tourists Miss
collections.description: Goa is 3,702 sq km of history, spice, wildlife, and waterfalls. The beaches are just the lobby.

collections.name: Highest Motorable Passes in India (Ranked)
collections.description: Every major pass ranked by altitude, with opening dates, road conditions, and whether your car/bike can actually handle it.

collections.name: Highest Places You Can Drive To
collections.description: Roads that make your ears pop and your engine gasp.

collections.name: India's Best Food Cities — Eat Your Way Across the Country
collections.description: These cities are worth visiting for the food alone. Each has a food culture so distinct that no restaurant outside can replicate it.

collections.name: India's Best Wildlife Safari Destinations
collections.description: From Bengal Tigers to Asian Elephants. India's national parks are among the best wildlife destinations on earth — and far more affordable than African safaris.

collections.name: India's Greatest Waterfalls
collections.description: From India's Niagara to the world's tallest plunge — waterfalls that justify the drive, the trek, or the boat ride to reach them.

collections.name: India's Most Spectacular Stepwells
collections.description: Before pipes and pumps, India built architectural masterpieces to reach underground water. Stepwells (baoli/vav) are inverted temples — descending into the earth instead of reaching for the sky. Most tourists walk past them. These are the ones worth seeking out.

collections.name: Island Hopping Andaman
collections.description: The essential 5-island circuit from Port Blair to Havelock, Neil, Ross, and North Bay — the complete Andaman experience in 6 days.

collections.name: Jyotirlinga Pilgrimage Trail
collections.description: Three of the twelve sacred Shiva Jyotirlingas in our coverage area — the most important pilgrimage in Shaivism, each representing a different form of light.

collections.name: Kerala Backwater Experiences — Life on Water
collections.description: Houseboats, canoe villages, and below-sea-level farming. Kerala's backwaters are the only place in India where life happens on water.

collections.name: Lakshadweep Coral Paradise
collections.description: India's best-kept island secret — pristine coral atolls, turquoise lagoons, permit required.

collections.name: Last Villages of India
collections.description: The edge of the map. Where the road ends and the border begins.

collections.name: Living Craft Heritage — Where Artisans Still Create By Hand
collections.description: From Kalamkari pen-painting to double-ikat weaving — India's living craft traditions you can watch, learn, and buy direct from the artisan.

collections.name: Living Root Bridges & Natural Wonders of Meghalaya
collections.description: Bridges grown from tree roots over centuries. Caves older than civilization. Rivers so clear boats appear to fly. Meghalaya is India's natural wonder cabinet.

collections.name: Luxury Heritage Stays — Sleep in Palaces and Forts
collections.description: Rajasthan's former rulers converted their ancestral properties into hotels. These are not "heritage-themed" — they are actual 300-500 year old forts and palaces where you sleep in rooms that once housed kings. Rates that would be budget-tier in Europe.

collections.name: Maharashtra Fort Trail — Shivaji's Legacy in Stone
collections.description: Maharashtra has 350+ forts — more than any Indian state. These are the ones worth the climb.

collections.name: Monasteries Older Than 500 Years
collections.description: Buddhist monasteries that have survived centuries. Each holds living traditions.

collections.name: Monsoon Destinations — Where Rain is the Main Event
collections.description: While most tourists flee the monsoon, these places come alive. Waterfalls at full roar, green everything, and zero crowds.

collections.name: Monsoon Magic (Jul-Sep)
collections.description: Destinations that come alive in the rains — waterfalls, green valleys, misty mountains, and fewer crowds.

collections.name: Most Beautiful Villages in India
collections.description: The villages that look like they belong in a travel documentary.

collections.name: Most Dangerous Roads (That Are Worth It)
collections.description: Cliff edges, no barriers, single lanes, and scenery that stops your heart.

collections.name: New Year's Eve Destinations — Where to Ring It In
collections.description: Not Goa. Not Bangkok. These North India destinations offer New Year's Eve experiences that range from bonfire in the snow to midnight prayers at the Golden Temple. Every one scored for late December.

collections.name: North India's Most Beautiful Rivers and Lakes
collections.description: From the crystal Umngot at Dawki to the sacred Ganga at Varanasi, from alpine Pangong to the jungle lakes of Ranthambore — water bodies that are destinations in themselves, not just scenery on the way to somewhere else.

collections.name: Northeast India: The Complete First-Timer's Circuit
collections.description: Two weeks. Eight states. One circuit. The logical route through India's most underexplored region — what to see, what to skip, and how to not waste time backtracking.

collections.name: Offbeat Andaman Islands
collections.description: Beyond Havelock — Long Island, Rangat, Diglipur, and Little Andaman for travelers who want the real island experience without the crowds.

collections.name: Offbeat Romantic Getaways — Not Manali, Not Shimla
collections.description: If your idea of romance is not sharing a traffic jam on Mall Road with 10,000 other couples, these destinations offer genuine intimacy — quiet valleys, private cottages, meals by firelight, and zero Instagram influencers staging photos in matching outfits.

collections.name: Places With Zero Phone Signal (And Why That's The Point)
collections.description: Where BSNL gives up and even God checks voicemail. These destinations force you to look up from your screen.

collections.name: Portuguese India Heritage Trail
collections.description: 450 years of Portuguese footprint along India's west coast.

collections.name: Proposal-Worthy Spots in North India
collections.description: If you are planning to ask the question, these locations have the setting, the privacy, and the emotional weight. Scored not for tourism but for a single, unrepeatable moment.

collections.name: Routes Where Your Fuel Tank Decides Everything
collections.description: These are the stretches where the gap between petrol pumps can kill your trip. Distances, locations, and backup plans.

collections.name: Sacred Lakes at Impossible Altitudes
collections.description: Frozen, turquoise, sacred, or all three. India's high-altitude lakes sit where humans have no business being — and they're worth every gasping breath.

collections.name: Safest for Solo Female Travelers
collections.description: Places with solid infrastructure, welcoming locals, active tourism presence, and reliable connectivity — tested and trusted by women who travel alone.

collections.name: Snow Leopard Territory — Where to See the Ghost Cat
collections.description: The snow leopard is the world's most elusive big cat. India has an estimated 700+ — the second-largest population after China. Seeing one is not guaranteed. It is never guaranteed. But these locations give you the best odds, in the right months, with the right guides.

collections.name: Spring Destinations — Where March to May Scores 5/5
collections.description: Spring in North India is the shoulder season nobody talks about. Snow is melting, wildflowers are blooming, tourists haven't arrived yet, and prices are half of peak. These destinations score 5/5 in spring — not because of marketing, but because weather, crowds, and infrastructure all align.

collections.name: Summer Escapes (Apr-Jun) — Where to Flee the Heat
collections.description: When the plains hit 45°C, these hill stations and mountain towns stay under 25°C. Not just "best hill stations" — destinations specifically scored for April, May, and June when you actually need them.

collections.name: Temple Trail — South India's Sacred Circuit
collections.description: The temples of South India are architectural wonders. Each one is a universe of sculpture, ritual, and faith built over millennia.

collections.name: The AP Buddhist Circuit — 2,200 Years of Enlightenment
collections.description: From the cradle of Mahayana Buddhism at Amaravati to the submerged monasteries of Nagarjuna Konda — a 2,200-year journey through South Indian Buddhism.

collections.name: The Char Dham Yatra — Complete Pilgrimage Circuit
collections.description: The four most sacred Hindu shrines in the Himalayas, connected by a 1,500km mountain circuit. Yamunotri → Gangotri → Kedarnath → Badrinath. This is not a weekend trip — it is a 10-14 day journey through some of India's most dramatic terrain. We score each shrine for every month and tell you which season makes the road dangerous.

collections.name: The Complete Buddhist Circuit
collections.description: Follow Siddhartha's path from enlightenment to Nirvana — every major Buddhist site in India, scored for every month, so you know exactly when to go and what to expect.

collections.name: The Complete Spiritual Circuit
collections.description: Temples, monasteries, ashrams, and sacred confluences — a journey across faiths and centuries.

collections.name: The Deccan Food Trail — Biryani, Haleem & Beyond
collections.description: From GI-tagged Hyderabadi haleem to Guntur chilli biryani, Araku coffee to Tirupati laddoo — the flavors that define AP and Telangana.

collections.name: The Godavari Trail — India's Unknown Backwaters
collections.description: Follow the Godavari from sacred ghats to delta backwaters — houseboats, mangroves, and 13 islands that rival Kerala without a single tourist.

collections.name: The Haveli Trail of Rajasthan
collections.description: Rajasthan's merchant families built mansions that rival European palaces — but most tourists drive past them to reach forts. The Haveli Trail connects four regions where painted facades, carved jharokhas, and frescoed courtyards survive in various states of magnificent decay.

collections.name: The Kakatiya Heritage Circuit — Telangana's Dynasty Trail
collections.description: Trace the Kakatiya dynasty from their capital at Warangal to their UNESCO temple at Ramappa — the gateway that became a state emblem.

collections.name: The Konkan Coast Road Trip — Mumbai to Goa by the Sea
collections.description: India's most scenic coastal drive. 600km of sea forts, fishing villages, Alphonso mangoes, and the best seafood on the west coast.

collections.name: The Mughal Trail
collections.description: Follow the arc of the Mughal Empire — from Delhi's Red Fort to Agra's Taj Mahal to Lucknow's Nawabi refinement to Orchha's defiant Bundela fortress that the Mughals never quite conquered.

collections.name: The Odisha Golden Triangle — Temples, Sun, Jagannath
collections.description: The essential Odisha circuit — from Temple City Bhubaneswar to Konark Sun Temple (UNESCO) to Jagannath's Char Dham at Puri. Three UNESCO-level heritage sites in 3 perfect days.

collections.name: The Panch Kedar Pilgrimage Trail
collections.description: Five ancient Shiva temples in the Garhwal Himalayas, each believed to house a body part of Shiva. Kedarnath is the most famous — but the other four are the trek that separates pilgrims from tourists. Total circuit: 170km of mountain trails over 12-16 days.

collections.name: The Rajasthan Fort Circuit
collections.description: Six fortress cities connected by desert highway — from Jaipur's Amber Fort to Jaisalmer's living citadel. Each fort tells a different chapter of Rajput resistance, Mughal diplomacy, and desert survival. This is not a "top forts" list — it is a driveable route with a logical sequence, scored for every month.

collections.name: The Sikh Heritage Trail — Gurdwaras, Battlefields, and History
collections.description: Five hundred years of Sikh history across three states — from the birthplace of Khalsa to the Golden Temple, from battlefield memorials to the world's largest community kitchen. Every site is free to visit. Every langar feeds you without asking your name.

collections.name: The Turtle Trail — World's Greatest Wildlife Spectacle
collections.description: Witness the greatest mass nesting event on Earth — 600,000 Olive Ridley turtles at Gahirmatha, saltwater crocodiles at Bhitarkanika, and dolphins at Chilika.

collections.name: Tiger Safari Circuit — Best Parks Across India
collections.description: Five national parks, five different ecosystems, five different probabilities of seeing a tiger. We don't promise sightings — we tell you which park, which zone, which month gives you the best odds, and what it actually costs. No sponsored safari operators. Just data.

collections.name: Tribal Cultures You Can Ethically Visit
collections.description: Not a zoo. Not a performance. These are communities that welcome visitors on their terms — with homestays, shared meals, and genuine cultural exchange.

collections.name: Tribal Odisha — 62 Cultures, Zero Tourism
collections.description: Deep into Odisha's tribal heartland — Dongria Kondh markets, Kutia Kondh pine forests, Chhau dance, hot springs, and responsible tourism at its most authentic.

collections.name: Truly Offbeat (Most Tourists Haven't Heard Of)
collections.description: Skip the Instagram spots. These are places most Indians haven't visited — raw, quiet, and unforgettable.

collections.name: UNESCO World Heritage — South & West India
collections.description: From the ruins of Vijayanagara to the caves of Ajanta. South and West India's UNESCO sites span 2,000 years of art, faith, and empire.

collections.name: UNESCO World Heritage Sites of India
collections.description: India has 42 UNESCO World Heritage Sites. These are the ones NakshIQ covers — from Himalayan railways to Deccan cave temples.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Bengaluru (Under 6 Hours)
collections.description: The IT capital's best escapes — coffee hills, wildlife, and heritage within half a day's drive.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Chandigarh (Under 6 Hours)
collections.description: Chandigarh sits at the gateway to the Himalayas. Within 6 hours, you can be in apple orchards, colonial hill stations, or snow-capped peaks. These are the escapes locals actually take — not the ones tourism boards promote.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Delhi (Under 8 Hours)
collections.description: Escape the capital chaos — all these are under 8 hours by road from Delhi. Leave Friday night, return Sunday.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Hyderabad (Under 4 Hours)
collections.description: Quick escapes from Hyderabad — forts, hills, heritage, and weaving villages all within a half-day drive.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Jaipur (Under 5 Hours)
collections.description: You live in Jaipur or you're visiting and want a 2-day escape. These destinations are all within 5 hours by road, scored for the current month, with honest drive-time estimates that account for actual road conditions — not Google Maps optimism.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Kochi (Under 4 Hours)
collections.description: Kerala's commercial capital is the gateway. Backwaters, hill stations, waterfalls — all within 4 hours.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Kolkata (Under 8 Hours)
collections.description: Kolkata is the gateway to the Eastern Himalayas, the Sundarbans mangroves, and Bengal's cultural heartland. Within 8 hours, you can reach tea estates, tiger territory, or the most peaceful town in India.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Lucknow (Under 6 Hours)
collections.description: Lucknow sits in the UP heartland — within 6 hours you can reach Himalayan foothills, Buddhist pilgrimage sites, tiger reserves, and the holiest city on earth. These are the escapes that don't require a flight.

collections.name: Weekend Getaways from Mumbai (Under 6 Hours)
collections.description: Escape Maximum City. Every option here is under 6 hours from Mumbai — leave Friday night, reset by Sunday.

collections.name: Wettest Places on Earth (And Why You Should Visit)
collections.description: Mawsynram and Cherrapunji fight over who gets more rain. Both win. Here's why the wettest corner of the planet is worth visiting — and when to actually go.

collections.name: Where Bikers Actually Sleep (Tested Stops)
collections.description: Not luxury hotels — the dhabas with parking, the homestays that let you work on your bike, the campsites where bikers congregate.
